tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Syntax, MX, disposable, role and free-provider checks on an email address (no message is sent). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, SPF and DMARC records for a domain via DNS over HTTPS. (cost: 1 credit)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-domain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check · Private data: domain_check · Public sink: email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check · Private data: domain_check · Public sink: email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
